mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the GDP growth is positive, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates a slowdown in economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate, signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending is expected to rise.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it indicates a broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between HOUST decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% in a month signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the RSAFS growth is positive, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
